decisive_items: Revealed raised liver enzyme levels and positive anti–hepatitis C virus antibody status
lichenoid plaques on the right angle of mouth, bilateral buccal mucosa, and erosions covered with hemorrhagic crusts on the upper and lower lips
response.rationale: The presence of hepatitis C virus antibody and raised liver enzyme levels in addition to lichenoid plaques suggests a specific connection between hepatitis C and lichen planus

rejected.why: Lacks specificity regarding the underlying cause of lichen planus
